expressions.en: Could you please help me with this?
expressions.bm_formal: Bolehkah anda tolong saya dengan ini?

expressions.en: I will get back to you.
expressions.cn: 我会再联系你 / 我会回复你。
expressions.bm_formal: Saya akan maklumkan semula kepada anda.

expressions.cn: 抱歉迟了 / 对不起，耽搁了。

expressions.en: Thank you for your cooperation / Appreciate your help.
expressions.cn: 感谢您的合作 / 谢谢你的帮助。
expressions.bm_formal: Terima kasih atas kerjasama anda / Saya menghargai bantuan anda.
expressions.bm_casual: Terima kasih banyak-banyak / Thanks atas bantuan.

work.scenario: Your manager asks for an update on a project you're still working on, and you need to request a colleague's input before giving a final answer.
key_phrases: Bolehkah anda tolong saya semak laporan ini secepat mungkin?
Kejap, saya check dulu dengan rakan sekerja.
Saya akan maklumkan semula kepada anda selepas dapat input penuh.

life.scenario: You're coordinating a potluck dinner with friends and need to confirm who's bringing what, but you're running a bit late on replies to their messages.
key_phrases: Sorry lambat reply, baru free ni.
Faham, nanti saya update dalam group list makanan.
Terima kasih banyak-banyak atas kerjasama semua!

tech.scenario: You're reporting a bug in a new software to the IT support team and they need to investigate, promising to get back to you with a solution.
key_phrases: Bolehkah anda bantu saya dengan masalah teknikal ini?
Biar saya semak log error dulu untuk diagnosis.
Nanti saya inform balik bila dah ada penyelesaian.
